query:
SELECT t.id, a.name
        FROM chat_turns t
        JOIN agents a ON a.id=t.conversation_id
        JOIN room_messages d ON d.id=t.room_message_id
        JOIN room_messages m ON m.id=$1 AND m.room_id=d.room_id
        WHERE t.id=$2 AND t.status IN ('queued','running','delegated')
        FOR UPDATE OF t
